gloss: way of making; how to make; recipe

definitions.gloss: way of making; how to make; method of preparation
definitions.explanation: The method or procedure for making something. Used for recipes, crafts, and any process of producing or building a thing.

examples.japanese: カレーの{作|つく}り{方|かた}を{習|なら}う。
examples.english: I learn how to make curry.

examples.japanese: この{箱|はこ}の{作|つく}り{方|かた}は{簡単|かんたん}だ。
examples.english: The way to make this box is simple.

examples.japanese: {動画|どうが}を{見|み}れば、{基本|きほん}の{作|つく}り{方|かた}がよくわかる。
examples.english: If you watch the video, the basic method is easy to understand.

notes:
The verb {作|つく}る (to make) plus 〜{方|かた} (way of doing). This 〜{方|かた} pattern attaches to a verb stem to mean "the way of ~ing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {料理|りょうり}の{作|つく}り{方|かた}: how to cook a dish; recipe
- {作|つく}り{方|かた}を{教|おし}える: to teach how to make something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- レシピ: recipe — specifically for food, listing ingredients and steps
- {使|つか}い{方|かた}: how to use — same 〜{方|かた} pattern with {使|つか}う
- {方法|ほうほう}: method — more abstract and formal
